title: the librarian's proofs reach no other device
intention: The librarian's proofs measure only the librarian: test_librarian_chat's stamp tooth captures what dual_seam sends on a recording bus instead of patching inference_domain's resolve over a scratch BusDevice, and test_librarian_loop's livelock tooth stops calling inference_domain's canonicalize.
why: Measured 2026-11-10 by encapsulation_breaches in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (ticket 124c0312c2d8, outline 17.13.1): cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_chat.py:396, cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_chat.py:409, cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_loop.py:55 import cairn.devices.inference_domain.domain and cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus.bus. RULE 1: a component's proofs measure only that component.
how: A recording bus replaces the in-process inference rig in the chat stamp tooth; the loop proof's canonicalize assert goes; a red-first proof asserts the sieve and runs both.

clauses.claim: encapsulation_breaches over the live tree reads no row whose source is cairn/devices/librarian

neither cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_chat.py nor cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_loop.py names a cairn.devices.inference_domain or cairn.devices.cairn module, and each, run as its own process, is green

decisions.text: D1: in cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_chat.py, test_the_seam_stamps_the_research_domain_declared_never_inferred drops its imports of cairn.devices.inference_domain.domain, cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus.bus.BusDevice and cairn.tools.bus_client._load_device_shim, and its patch of domain_module.resolve. In their place a local class _RecordingBus with a request(self, *, sender, to, verb, why, body) method appends (to, verb, dict(body)) to a list and returns {'body': {'answer': {'text': 'x', 'vector': [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]}, 'hit': False, 'provenance': {}}}; seam = live.dual_seam(_RecordingBus()) is called with the same three requests. Each recorded call must have to == 'inference_domain' and verb == 'resolve' (what cairn/devices/librarian/live.py _bus_resolve sends), and the three domain assertions stand unchanged over the recorded bodies. The docstring gains one sentence: what inference_domain does with the domain is measured at its own address.

D2: in cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_loop.py, delete line 55 'from cairn.devices.inference_domain import domain' and, in test_the_livelock_is_broken_by_key_physics, the k1/k2 canonicalize lines and their assert. In their place a comment: inference_domain keys its cache on the canonical request (cairn/devices/inference_domain/domain.py canonicalize, measured at its own proofs), so a changed prompt is a changed key; the librarian's half is that the prompt changed, which the p1 != p2 and GRAPH-STATE asserts above measure.

D3: the proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_the_librarian_proofs_reach_no_device.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES a16c4d4ff4bd 1 and 2, shaped like cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_domain_proofs_reach_no_device.py: tooth 1 filters encapsulation_breaches(repo) (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) for source 'cairn/devices/librarian'; tooth 2 reads both proofs' text for 'cairn.devices.inference_domain' and 'cairn.devices.cairn', and if neither is named runs each with subprocess (PYTHONPATH=repo, timeout 600) and requires exit 0.

out: every other cross-device reach, each its own ticket under 8e3474a6ae43
